site_subtitle: Gut microbiome, enteric neuroscience, supersulfides, PTMs, and neuroimmunology
topic_scope: Include a paper only when its central question or principal finding is directly related to at least one of these five areas: (1) gut microbiome, gut bacteria, microbial metabolism, or intestinal host-microbe interaction; (2) enteric nervous system, enteric neurons or glia, intestinal neural circuits, motility, or visceral sensation; (3) supersulfides, persulfides, polysulfides, reactive sulfur species, or protein persulfidation/supersulfidation; (4) protein post-translational modifications, especially mechanistic studies of covalent protein modification; (5) neuroimmunology, neuroinflammation, or bidirectional nervous-immune interactions. Exclude papers whose connection is incidental.
